thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: spike in 5xx + connection_reset observed across ingress cluster in euc2 (eastus2). Affected load balancer: alb-prod-euc2-ingress. Error rate >20% for last 3m. Paging oncall.

oncall-pager: paging @sre-jen (primary) and @network-dan (net). please ack.

sre-jen: ack — looking.

sre-jen: quick sketch — symptoms: client-side connection resets, Envoy reports downstream connection resets and 502s; ALB target group shows high 5xx from targets. Need blast radius and impact numbers.

alex: adding logs — ALB shows HealthCheck succeeded for targets but TargetResponseTime spikes, and many "Connection reset by peer" in envoy.

alex: snippet from envoy:
```
[envoy][warning] connection error: remote close, id=0x8f
http: downstream reset stream
```

network-dan: confirmed similar in NLB/ALB metrics. I see increased SYN/FIN rates in AZ-b. Could be NIC/host networking flap in that AZ. Checking cloud provider alarms now.

eng-ops-lucy: running quick kubectl to see pod restarts and readiness:
```
kubectl -n ingress get pods -o wide
NAME                       READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   NODE
ingress-abc-1              2/2     Running   0          ip-10-0-2-45
ingress-abc-2              1/2     CrashLoop 12         ip-10-0-3-12  # AZ-b
```

eng-ops-lucy: ingress pod in AZ-b crashlooping on envoy with repeated connection failures to local networking (kernel logs show RSTs)

sre-jen: customer impact — preliminary: ~18-25% of requests in euc2 return 5xx or timeout for the last 4-6 minutes. We'll start mitigation: 1) drain AZ-b from ALB targets 2) shift traffic weighting to other AZs 3) restart ingress replicas on affected nodes 4) if persists, failover region-level routing.

sre-jen: @network-dan can you remove targets in AZ-b from alb-prod-euc2-ingress target-group? Use short-circuit weighted routing after.

network-dan: on it. Running:
```
aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:aws:... --targets Id=i-0abc123,Id=i-0def456
```

network-dan: deregister request submitted. ALB health will rebalance. Note: DNS remains same; routing change is at LB target-level.

alex: starting rolling restart for ingress pods in AZ-b to clear kernel-level conn states:
```
kubectl rollout restart deploy/ingress -n ingress --field-selector spec.nodeName=ip-10-0-3-12
```

eng-ops-lucy: restart done for node ip-10-0-3-12, new pod reached Ready=2/2

sre-jen: monitoring: error-rate trending down to 5xx ~6% in euc2 now. Latency improved. Continue to monitor for 10m before declaring mitigated.

cs-amy: flagging customer impact for CS — which tenants hit worst? any large customers affected?

alex: quick query against logs shows many distinct tenant-ids, highest % was tenant=acme-inc ~22% of affected, others distributed. Ticketing CS now.

network-dan: cloud provider reports degraded network interface in AZ-b for some hosts — they're investigating NIC driver issues. We'll keep targets out until provider confirms remediation.

sre-jen: placing a short mitigation note — will not re-add AZ-b targets until provider confirms stable. Escalating to infra-eng to track provider response.

eng-ops-lucy: creating pager duty handoff to night oncall, adding context + commands executed and current status.

oncall-pager: handoff scheduled to @sre-night at 2359127200. Note: ongoing mitigation persists; ALB targets in AZ-b remain drained. Current error rate euc2: 5xx 4.8% (down from 23%).

sre-jen: agreed — followup actions: 1) keep drained until provider declares fix 2) run targeted soak tests to validate re-add 3) create postmortem doc with timeline and customer impact 4) notify customers in incidents page if >10% of requests or >10min sustained.

cs-amy: opening customer incident page and templating messages. Will send targeted note to affected accounts in next 20m.

incident-bot: NOTE: incident created — INC-2359123456. Assigned sev: 2. Channel: #incidents. Postmortem required.

sre-jen: closing realtime mitigation — continuing monitoring. If any regression >5% error for 5m, immediate page to pager duty. Thanks everyone :heart:

eng-ops-lucy: adding final runbook commands used to thread for postmortem:
- aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn ... --targets Id=...,Id=...
- kubectl rollout restart deploy/ingress -n ingress --selector topology.kubernetes.io/zone=us-east-2b
- kubectl get pods -n ingress -o wide

sre-jen: last check at 2359123890 — euc2 5xx stabilized at 3.7%, ALB target healthy count: AZ-b 0, AZ-a 12, AZ-c 10. Recording for postmortem.
